snippet.title: Kinny and the Cosmic Cauldron - Cooking Deckbuilder - Gameplay Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description:
Cook or be cooked! In this cosmic deck-building roguelike, ingredients crash, merge, and react in chaotic ways. As the witch chef of Stewpendous Spoons, craft the perfect stew, master strategic combos, and satisfy bizarre patrons—before you end up in the cauldron yourself!

Play the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330210/Kinny_and_the_Cosmic_Cauldron/

Trailer Music by Subeen Kim
